title: Hernán Núñez (Stockholm) to Fuenmayor (Copenhagen), December 1674, DECODE R1012-R1015

steps.what: Parsed DECODE's DOC transcriptions into cipher tokens and margin text; normalised g.3 to que.
Aligner run per image, with no anchors.
Seven anchors from the repeated pair representado / representare; aligner per record.
Recognised the values as the Balbases 1677 key and applied it unchanged.
The key reproduces the margins of all four letters; 167, 161, os, 30, 6+, 4 were added from context.

outcome.fraction_read_source: read/R*.txt headers, Balbases key on DECODE transcription groups: 1,716 groups, 118 unknown (R1012 62/624, R1013 20/372, R1014 29/484, R1015 7/236); unknowns are mostly DECODE transcription slips, and every passage has a verified contemporary margin decipherment
outcome.notes: Margins verified and illegible margin words recovered from the key. Attack corrected 22 Sept 2026 from 'known plaintext': every passage carries its contemporary margin decipherment, and the Balbases 1677 key (balbases1677/key.json) was applied unchanged.

prior.where: Marginal decipherments on every passage; sibling key rebuilt in this project for balbases1677
